messages.subject: Issues with conflicting compiler
parts:
Hi NIMBLE developers,
I am trying to run NIMBLE on MacOS (Monterey 12.6.3). Fresh install of Xcode and NIMBLE from CRAN but got the following error messages. It appears to be conflicting issues with unresolved references to the isfinite, isinf, and isnan functions. However, I am not sure how to fix the problem. 

Below is the full error messages. Thank you for your help!

> cfoo <- compileNimble(foo)

messages.author: d78486bfff620d81
messages.subject: Re: Issues with conflicting compiler
parts:
Yeah, as you suggest, I suspect this is not a nimble issue, but rather something with how the compiler (or perhaps multiple different compilers) is installed. Have you installed anything via HomeBrew or MacPorts?

Are you able to run a basic Rcpp example? 

```
Rcpp::cppFunction(
          'int fibonacci(const int x) {
              if (x == 0) return(0);
              if (x == 1) return(1);
              return (fibonacci(x - 1)) + fibonacci(x - 2);
          }')

fibonacci(7)
```
